I am a farmer here in Mtwara, and this sorghum plot is what feeds my family. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer, and sorghum is a hardy crop that grows well on our soils without it. I will use the seeds I saved from last season like my father did, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to help the soil. The rains must do the watering — I have no pump, no irrigation here.
